items.title: The AI Wealth Problem
items.summary: An agentic swarm pulls off what looks like the first large-scale AI-powered cyber attack, Wall Street argues about whether the bubble is bursting, and Anthropic commits roughly 20% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund — reigniting a debate as old as the Gilded Age about who gets to decide what the 'public good' means when private AI wealth dwarfs public institutions.
